reports.title: Índice de Preços no Consumidor (IPC)
reports.description: Mozambique's national CPI, confirmed via INE's own DDI/NADA metadata catalog (mozdata.ine.gov.mz — the main ine.gov.mz site returned TLS resets throughout this round). Published monthly, one bulletin per provincial capital plus a national "Nota de Imprensa." INE's own Nota Metodológica (base 2016=100, updated February 2020) explicitly names BOTH the UN COICOP standard AND the "Manual do IPC das Nações Unidas 2009" [UN/ILO/World Bank/IMF CPI Handbook 2009] by name — one of the most explicit methodology-manual citations found anywhere in this branch.
reports.cadence_note: Monthly; one bulletin per provincial capital plus a national press note.

reports.title: SADC Harmonised Consumer Price Indices (HCPI) News Release, Issue No. 75
reports.description: A SADC-Secretariat-authored HCPI bulletin, hosted on ine.gov.mz's own domain (under "Estatísticas / Anuário e Outras Publicações"). Lists Mozambique's monthly HCPI values by name and states: "The SADC HCPI is compiled by the SADC Secretariat by aggregating the National HCPIs of the Member States." CAVEAT: this is SADC's own authorial voice, not an INE-authored statement — INE hosts/files it as one of its own official publications, but no INE-authored (not merely hosted) document naming SADC directly could be found this round (the more likely candidate page on the live ine.gov.mz site was unreachable). Distinct from the existing corpus-wide sadc-hcpi-newsletter node — kept separate rather than merged, since the underlying document (Issue No. 75) and the hosting/authorship situation are both different from the Stage-1 SADC bulletin already wired to the other 8 SADC countries.
reports.cadence_note: Recurring numbered issue series ("Issue No. 75" implies at least 75 prior editions).

reports.title: Decreto n.º 40/2023
reports.description: Decree of 7 July 2023 (Boletim da República), establishing a revenue-sharing mechanism from mining and oil taxes to provinces, districts, and local communities. Article 5 states verbatim: "7.25% destinados à província e distritos... 2.75% destinados às comunidades locais" [7.25% allocated to the province and districts... 2.75% allocated to local communities]. Cites Lei n.º 20/2014 (Lei de Minas) and Lei n.º 21/2014 (Lei de Petróleo) as its statutory basis. Verified via downloaded PDF + pdftotext extraction, not AI-summarized.

reports.title: Lei n.º 5/2023 (alterando a Lei n.º 3/2019)
reports.description: Mozambique's 2024 decentralisation reform: the legal framework for directly electing Provincial Governors and Provincial Assembly members, established by Lei n.º 3/2019 and amended by Lei n.º 5/2023. Corroborated by a CIP (Centro de Integridade Pública) civil-society report quoting Constitution Article 278 and Lei n.º 6/2019. Verified via downloaded PDF + pdftotext extraction, not AI-summarized.
